title: tc-session-context-bar
description:
The session's declared terms kept in view – intent, knowledge mode, scope, review, posture, limits, deadline and
budget – as labelled chips, with "+N more" for the rest.

terms.description: The terms, in the order they show; the ones that don't fit go behind "+N more"

label.description: The bar's name for screen readers

editable.description: Every term is editable unless it says otherwise

locked.description: The terms are fixed for the session: a lock shows at the start and nothing is editable

sticky.description: Sticks to the top of the scroller it's in (default true)

stickyTop.description: How far from the top it sticks, in px – the height of a header above it

maxVisible.description: Show at most this many chips, however wide the bar is

termLabels.description: Labels for term ids – in place of the usual ones (Intent, Knowledge …) or for your own ids

meterWarn.description: The meter's tone turns warning from this share used (default 0.75)

id.description: Stable id; the eight usual terms take their label from it: intent, knowledge, scope, review, posture, release, deadline, budget

label.description: The label; unset, the usual one for the id, else the id

value.description: The value, shown as given: "Sources and model knowledge", "Fri 17:00"

meter.description: How much is used, 0–1: shows a small meter beside the value (a budget)

editable.description: The chip is a button that fires tc-term-edit; unset follows the bar's `editable`

description.description: A longer line, shown in the "+N more" list and as the chip's tooltip (else the tooltip is the label and value, for a value cut short)

SessionTerm.description: One declared term of the session

SessionTermTone.description: A term's colour – the value's words carry the meaning, the colour points at it
